en:
Uggghhh... How could I have eaten so much?
It was pathetic of me...
<CLT=cltMIND>Should I hang out with Kaito for a while?

O-Okay, then let's run!
I'm gonna run off all that food!

<CLT=cltMIND>Kaito and I did some laps
around the courtyard.
<CLT=cltMIND>Kaito and I grew a little closer today.
